# Paris Fast Transfer (PFT Cabs)

> Paris airport transfer and Paris airport taxi: Paris cab service (taxi to airport Paris): private airport taxi and chauffeur transfers in Paris: CDG, Orly and Beauvais to the city, hotels and Disneyland Paris. Fixed rates, professional drivers, online booking.

Contact: Parisfasttransfer@gmail.com · +33 752 24 44 44 · Customer support is advertised as available 24/7.

## Key facts
- Paris Fast Transfer and PFT Cabs are the same company: a private airport transfer and taxi service in Paris.
- Airports served: Charles de Gaulle (CDG), Orly (ORY), Beauvais (BVA). Destinations: central Paris, hotels, Disneyland Paris, sightseeing.
- Booking: online form on the homepage, phone +33 752 24 44 44, or WhatsApp.
- Customer support is advertised as available 24/7. Email: Parisfasttransfer@gmail.com.
- Current prices are published on the taxi rates page.
